ABSOLUTE OWNER LAW — FRANKENSTEIN AVATAR / ai-core-node / 2026-09-12

ONE PRODUCTION GUI / ONE PRODUCTION CHROME WINDOW ONLY.

Target = the existing chat-bearing FranKenstein GUI on physical screen 2 (HDMI-A-0). Keep it visible there.

MANDATORY FOR EVERY WORKER:
- First detect/reuse the existing production window.
- After normal HTML/CSS/JS/avatar changes: REFRESH/RELOAD THAT EXISTING WINDOW ONLY.
- NEVER open a new production Chrome/kiosk just to see a change.
- NEVER build/promote a second/third parallel production GUI.
- If the production window is genuinely absent, open exactly ONE on screen 2, then reuse that singleton thereafter.
- Scratch/shadow browsers must be isolated, labeled, must not replace screen-2 production, and must be closed after the test.
- If duplicates exist, preserve the intended screen-2 chat-bearing production subject and remove only confirmed duplicates.
- Bind by service + URL + title/class + screen geometry; PIDs/window IDs are ephemeral.

Canonical repo policy: research_entity/coordination/AVATAR_SINGLETON_POLICY.md
